criteria.description: Provider call protocol and payment flow: paypal/create, return and cancel handlers, abandon, void rule with the resolution hook, order presentation and receipt
Verified PayPal webhooks: pre-checks, per-IP limit, signature verification, dedupe among valid events, merchant-scoped mapping
criteria.notes:
The e3 plan command passes 117/117.

Every event now has an explicit origin list, checked before the state table, which stays as a second gate (L266-L273). I checked the seven lists against the spec and states.js:
- CREATED: approved and authorization_pending only, never from unknown. This is the spec's 'pending -> authorized'; approved is the same moment before the return handler records it.
- VOIDED: from authorized and unknown(authorized).
- COMPLETED: from authorized, capture_pending and the same two as unknown.
- PENDING: from authorized and unknown(authorized).
- DENIED: from capture_pending and unknown(capture_pending).
- REFUNDED: from refund_pending and unknown(refund_pending).
- ORDER.APPROVED: informational.
Every listed edge exists in states.js. No list admits a terminal state or a backwards money move, except DENIED capture_pending -> authorized, which is correct because a denied capture moved no money.

The mapping table has 42 rows, including the three TR-E-1 rows.

Mutants killed:
- N1 (iteration-1 origins restored, 7 red);
- N1b (capture_pending added, 1 red);
- N1c (unknown(authorized) added, 1 red);
- N1d (origin gate removed, 5 red);
- the iteration-1 kills M14, M15 and M16.

My probe P1F/P2F passes. Security's 133-pair matrix through the real route agrees.

findings.title: Contract deltas 22-28 judged acceptable; carried to verification-report item 14
findings.detail:
Deltas 22-25 are as in iteration 1; 22 is narrowed by the fix. The new ones:
- 26: explicit origin lists, so a late duplicate under a new transmission id is stored flagged instead of ignored. It changes nothing, and nothing in src/ reads flagged rows: operator noise only (SEC-E2-I3). Acceptable.
- 27: CREATED never resolves unknown; the other five events resolve unknown only forward, from their fromUnknown lists. It is now recorded by dec-mv3yo8bf-01a4492b. Safe: every such move is forward to what the provider reports, the call row stays for the reconciler's read, and P2F and security's Q4 show it. Acceptable.
- 28: return and cancel share a limit of min(30, RS_GENERAL_RATE_LIMIT) per window, before the token lookup and any provider call. The 30 is a constant. Acceptable.
findings.recommendation: Owner: delivery-lead, verification-report item 14 (followups.md). FU-43 (optional, f3) for the not_approved/check_failed notice.

resolvedFindings.resolution:
Resolved, together with SEC-E-1. Every resolution condition holds on the final tree:
1. CREATED has from ['approved','authorization_pending'] and an empty fromUnknown.
2. capture_pending, captured, authorized and unknown(any) are flagged TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED, with no column change.
3. The mapping table has the three TR-E-1 rows and 39 others.
4. My iteration-1 probe, re-run unchanged, no longer reproduces: 0/2, the event answered flagged, A stays capture_pending or unknown (ev:ev-mv3yhw7n-01db6e6b, failing by design). Security's W-ORDER likewise no longer reproduces.
5. The suites are green.

My fixed-behaviour probe (ev:ev-mv3yi1ke-0128bcf5) shows the event flagged with the row unchanged. The pending purchase completes with no void and no refund (2 captures). While the reads fail, the unknown capture is not re-sent; it is resolved by the reconciler's read, with no capture of A re-sent.

My mutants N1, N1b, N1c and N1d, which restore or widen the origin lists, are killed by the mapping table (ev:ev-mv3zbbwo-011987bb). The e3 plan command passes 117/117 (ev:ev-mv3yos6x-0128afdb).

Resolved, together with SEC-E-2. The return and cancel routes share a limit of min(30, RS_GENERAL_RATE_LIMIT) per user per window. It is taken in one transaction before the token lookup and any provider call. The 31st hit is 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After and makes no provider call; another buyer, an anonymous caller and the next window are unaffected (test L416; e2 command 93/93, ev:ev-mv3yoq1h-01b02466).

Mutants N2 (removed), N3b (after the provider read, off cancel) and N3c (limit 300) are killed (ev:ev-mv3zbbwo-011987bb). N3 (after the token lookup) survives without effect on the provider bound (TR-E-10). Security's P-RATE confirms there is no evasion.

Resolved. approval-roundtrip.js asserts the return and cancel log line's userId and role unconditionally (L101-L102). My N5 (app.js session-user copy removed) turns journey-happy red at both widths (ev:ev-mv3zbbwo-011987bb), which reproduces e6's scratch red control (ev:ev-mv3xxni9-01261164). The browser suite is 10/10 on the final tree (ev:ev-mv3yoe93-016c0a61).
